stations.title: Idris
stations.say: What is the price of item three?

stations.title: Tokenizer
stations.text: A long flat row of marks, names and numbers.

captions: At Ashgrove Press, Idris wants the price of one item on the paper list.
The tokenizer gives a flat row of pieces, and nothing knows which ones make an item.
You write a parser that reads arrays and objects inside each other, in three tasks.
Now the list reads as items, and item three has a price Idris can use.
Same paper list, and the shop reads it into values as deep as they go.
